_comment: Natural-language grouping (engine relations from-text): words for functions, games, aircraft classes and aircraft. Terms are normalised like the request (lower case, punctuation and letter/digit boundaries become spaces, plural s dropped), so 'F-16', 'f16' and 'F 16' are the same term. Function variants list the DB/Functions/slots.json slots they stand for; 'default': false variants are only taken when the request names them.
_function_info: What each function does on the aircraft (system + effect) and which functions are its close relatives. Shown to the local model with every candidate and used for the catalog word search; 'related' functions are offered to the model next to a recognised one and named for aircraft that lack the asked function.

airbrake.about: extends or retracts the speed brake / air brake / dive brakes / spoilers to add drag and slow down; usually a throttle or stick switch

gear.about: raises or lowers the landing gear (undercarriage, wheels) with the gear lever

flaps.about: moves the wing flaps up, down or to a take-off/manoeuvre notch for more lift at low speed

trim_hat.about: trim hat on the stick: forward/up trims nose down, aft/down nose up, left/right trims roll; press resets trim

trim.about: trims pitch (nose up/down) and roll (wing down) so the aircraft flies hands-off; also trim reset and force trim release

force_trim.about: helicopter force trim / magnetic brake / trim release button: holds or releases the cyclic trim position

cms.about: countermeasures dispenser switch or hat: forward starts the dispense program or drops flares, aft drops chaff or panic program, left/right select or step programs, depress starts the jammer (ECM)

flare.about: drops flares (infrared decoys against heat-seeking missiles); in most cockpits this is CMS forward or the flare button that starts the countermeasure program

chaff.about: drops chaff (radar decoys against radar-guided missiles); in most cockpits this is CMS aft or the chaff button

ecm.about: switches the electronic countermeasures jammer (ECM pod) on/off; CMS depress on many jets

tms.about: target management switch (TMS hat on the stick): designates, steps and locks targets in the sensors and targeting pod

dms.about: display management switch (DMS hat): selects and cycles the cockpit displays (A-10)

master_arm.about: master arm switch: arms (ARM/ON) or safes (SAFE/OFF) all weapons release circuits

nws.about: engages nose wheel steering on the ground (on many jets the same button selects air refuelling or lasing in flight)

canopy.about: opens or closes (and locks) the cockpit canopy or hood

tailhook.about: lowers or raises the arresting tail hook for carrier or field arrested landings

launchbar.about: extends or retracts the nose gear launch bar for the carrier catapult

wingfold.about: folds or spreads the wings for carrier deck parking

refuel_probe.about: extends or retracts the air-to-air refuelling probe

afterburner.about: afterburner / reheat or war emergency power (WEP, boost) for maximum thrust

reverse.about: thrust reversers / reverse thrust after landing

dragchute.about: deploys or jettisons the drag (brake) parachute after landing

antiskid.about: switches the wheel brake anti-skid system on or off

parking_brake.about: sets or releases the parking brake (hand brake)

wheel_brakes.about: left and right wheel brakes (toe brake axes or brake buttons) for stopping and differential steering

rudder.about: rudder pedal axis (yaw; anti-torque pedals in helicopters)

flight_controls.about: the primary flight control axes: pitch, roll and rudder

throttle.about: throttle / thrust lever / power lever axis per engine (left, right or combined); collective in some helicopters

zoom.about: view zoom / field of view axis

tdc.about: target designator control (TDC / cursor / slew): moves the radar or display cursor (axes or hat) and designates with a press

weapon_release.about: weapon release / pickle button: drops bombs, fires rockets and launches missiles

trigger.about: gun trigger (first detent camera/laser, second detent fires the gun or cannon)

select_gun.about: selects the gun / dogfight gun mode

uncage.about: uncages the missile seeker so it tracks the target

gun_arm.about: gun arm / safe switch or gun safety lever

jettison.about: jettisons stores, weapons or fuel tanks in an emergency (emergency or selective jettison)

fuel_dump.about: dumps fuel or jettisons the drop tanks

kneeboard.about: shows/hides the kneeboard and turns its pages

landing_lights.about: landing and taxi lights on or off

nav_lights.about: navigation / position lights on or off

collision_lights.about: anti-collision strobe or beacon lights on or off

ext_lights.about: master switch of all exterior lights on or off

flashlight.about: pilot's flashlight / torch on or off

nvg.about: puts on / takes off the night vision goggles and sets their gain

autopilot.about: autopilot engage/disengage and modes: altitude hold, attitude hold, route/heading, hover hold

ap_disconnect.about: autopilot disconnect (paddle switch on the stick)

radar.about: radar power on / standby, target lock and unlock, antenna elevation and azimuth, TWS/RWS mode

radar_lock.about: locks the radar on a target (single target track)

radar_elevation.about: tilts the radar antenna up or down

radar_azimuth.about: moves the radar scan left or right

sensor_select.about: sensor select switch (SSS, castle switch): chooses which display or sensor is in control

china_hat.about: china hat on the throttle: field of view, sensor and cursor shortcuts

waypoint.about: steps to the next or previous waypoint / steerpoint

apu.about: starts the auxiliary power unit (APU) or jet fuel starter (JFS)

radiator.about: opens or closes the radiator / oil cooler flaps of piston engines

rpm.about: propeller pitch / RPM lever (axis or increase/decrease) or rotor RPM beep

mixture.about: mixture lever of piston engines or the thrust nozzle angle of VTOL jets (axis)

tailwheel.about: locks or unlocks the tail wheel

comm.about: comm switch / push to talk: transmit on radio 1 or 2, intercom (ICS) or IFF

intercom.about: intercom (ICS) push to talk to the crew

easy_comms.about: opens the simplified radio / F10 communication menu

master_caution.about: resets the master caution / master warning light

fbw.about: disconnects or overrides the fly-by-wire / flight control system

hmd.about: helmet mounted display (JHMCS/HMCS) on/off and brightness

seat.about: changes to the pilot, rear (WSO/RIO/CPG) or other crew seat

nav_mode.about: selects the master mode: navigation, air-to-ground, air-to-air or landing

crew_ai.about: AI crew member (Jester, Iceman, George, Petrovich): toggle and menu navigation

game_profiles._comment: Games whose binds are shared by all their aircraft (one catalog entry per game). 'mixed' games also fly other kinds of aircraft, so a class or role only partly fits them.
